candidates.change_summary: Replace 'require(msg.value == 10 ether);' with 'require(msg.value == 0 ether);' so fallback accepts calls with zero ether, changing balance and transfer behavior.
Delete 'require(block.timestamp > pastBlockTime);' so fallback no longer requires strict timestamp ordering, making it callable repeatedly in the same block.
Replace 'if(block.number % 15 == 0)' with 'if(block.number % 15 != 0)' so transfer occurs on blocks not divisible by 15 instead.
Replace 'payable(msg.sender).transfer(address(this).balance);' with 'payable(address(0)).transfer(address(this).balance);' so balance is sent to zero address instead of the caller.
Delete the entire if block that performs the transfer, so balance is never transferred to caller, only accumulated.
Move 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp;' inside the if block so it only updates when transfer occurs, changing subsequent timestamp checks.
Insert 'pastBlockTime = block.timestamp + 1;' after the existing timestamp update so future calls require strictly increasing timestamp, changing when calls are allowed.
